dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, who are you going to talk about in class next week?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈhuː ər juː ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ɪn ˈklæs ˈnɛkst ˈwiːk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Kanya Siriwong. She's my favorite writer, and I've just read her biography.
dialogue.reading: ˈkɑːnjə ˈsɪriwɔːŋ. ʃiːz maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈraɪtər, ənd aɪv ˈdʒʌst ˈriːd hɜːr baɪˈɑːɡrəfi.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She was born in a small village in Nan, in northern Thailand.
dialogue.reading: ʃiː wʌz ˈbɔːrn ɪn ə ˈsmɔːl ˈvɪlɪdʒ ɪn ˈnɑːn, ɪn ˈnɔːrðərn ˈtaɪlænd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In 1984. She lost her parents when she was five, so she became an orphan.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ˈnaɪntiːn ˈeɪti ˈfɔːr. ʃiː ˈlɔːst hɜːr ˈpɛrənts wɛn ʃiː wʌz ˈfaɪv, soʊ ʃiː bɪˈkeɪm ən ˈɔːrfən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Her grandmother did. Kanya comes from a very poor background.
dialogue.reading: hɜːr ˈɡrænmʌðər ˈdɪd. ˈkɑːnjə ˈkʌmz frəm ə ˈvɛri ˈpʊr ˈbækɡraʊnd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Many great writers come from difficult backgrounds. By the way, were you born in Bangkok, Nam?
dialogue.reading: ˈmɛni ˈɡreɪt ˈraɪtərz ˈkʌm frəm ˈdɪfɪkəlt ˈbækɡraʊndz. baɪ ðə ˈweɪ, wɜːr juː ˈbɔːrn ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk, ˈnɑːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I was born in Bangkok, on June 5th, 2006. And you, Mr. Brown?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ wʌz ˈbɔːrn ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk, ɑːn ˈdʒuːn ˈfɪfθ, ˈtuː ˈθaʊzənd ˈsɪks. ənd juː, ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I was born on a farm in Canada, a long time ago!
dialogue.reading: aɪ wʌz ˈbɔːrn ɑːn ə ˈfɑːrm ɪn ˈkænədə, ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈtaɪm əˈɡoʊ!
